answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation that grows like a vine: an agent must lock a refundable deposit before trading, and each verified honest job extends its vine of trust by a small credit, while a failed attestation slashes part of the bond. New identities start at an onyx-hard floor of zero trust, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits. Peers route valuable work only along long vines, and an opal-clear public ledger exposes every slash, so a sybil farm pays full price per fake identity while earning almost nothing.
